_comment: Reviewed acceptances for `scripts/dependency_audit.py`. Every key is a pip-audit advisory id; every entry names the package and an acceptance `reason`. `transitive-cap` means an installed dependency caps the package below the fixed version (`capped_by` names it) — the gate re-derives that cap from the installed environment and FAILS if it no longer holds. `no-fix-released` means no released version of the package fixes the advisory yet — the gate re-checks the same way. Nothing here is a permanent ignore: a relaxed upstream cap or a published fix turns the entry STALE and reds the gate. Evidence: docs/audits/NEXUS_OMNI_SECURITY_PRIVACY_AUDIT_2026-11-03.md (dependency section).

PYSEC-2026-311.note: Pre-auth code injection; fixed version not yet released (1.5.9 is the latest on PyPI and still affected). chromadb is an OPTIONAL RAG backend, imported lazily in features/rag.py; the project does not expose a chroma HTTP server. Re-check when chromadb > 1.5.9 ships.

PYSEC-2026-3813.note: Cross-tenant collection read/write; same unreleased fix as PYSEC-2026-311. Only reachable with a multi-tenant chroma server, which NEXUS does not run.

PYSEC-2026-3814.note: Code injection; same unreleased fix. See PYSEC-2026-311.

PYSEC-2026-3815.note: SimpleRBACAuthorizationProvider tenant/db/collection scope check; same unreleased fix.

PYSEC-2026-2447.note: Unsafe pickle deserialization. diskcache is a transitive of the optional llama_cpp_python (local-llm extra), not a first-party dependency, and no released version fixes it (5.6.3 is latest and still affected). Not on any default path.

CVE-2026-112940.note: ReadWriteLock SQLite lock-db symlink overwrite. Fixed in 4.2.1, but litellm (declared `litellm>=1.74,<2`) requires `filelock<4.0,>=3.16.1` — still true on litellm 1.108.0 — so 4.2.1 is unresolvable. Local-privilege attack, not remote. Re-check when litellm relaxes the cap.

CVE-2026-112913.note: Same litellm filelock<4.0 cap as CVE-2026-112940.

CVE-2026-112936.note: Fixed 4.0.9, still above the litellm <4.0 cap.
